claim: Register CURRENT 2026 City wayfinding map pixel coordinates onto WGS84 / the city world projection using STABLE OSM control points only, then read approximate map anchors for the named features from Captain-verified map pixels. The map is a stylised relief diagram, not an orthophoto: every map-derived anchor is approximate. No coordinate is invented from prose; every anchor names the pixel it was read at and the source that made it readable.

map.source: City of Toronto, Biidaasige Park wayfinding map, September 2026
map.orientation: NORTH-UP (Lake Shore top, Ship Channel bottom). The August 2025 PDF is SOUTH-UP and MUST NOT be used with these pixels.
map.mapTextSource: City of Toronto; copyright September 2026, printed City wayfinding map.
map.approxErrorNote: Map relief/labels are placed for legibility, not surveyed. Registered feature anchors carry an explicit approximate source error; they are NOT control-grade. Do not report them as precise.
map.pixelOrigin: upper-left; (0,0) is the top-left of the derived 2319x3000 PNG

projection.comment: The city world frame the anchors are expressed in is js/city-config.js worldFromLatLon (detail/eglinton share it). lat0/lon0/kx/ky/theta come from data/toronto-geodata.bin frame.projection (see tools/audit-biidaasige-ground.mjs).

controls.name: firehall_body
controls.note: Captain read the Fire Hall BODY at (1309,1752); registered to the CURRENT OSM building centroid.

controls.name: cherry_south_bridge
controls.note: Captain read the road-crossing CENTRE; the map exaggerates the bridge structure, so the OSM road centroid is the matching feature.

controls.name: cherry_commissioners_jct

controlPolicy.note: Only STABLE control points are fitted: Fire Hall body, two bridge road-crossings, two road junctions. The unnamed OSM west-playground AREA CENTROID is NOT a control and is NOT the Owl — fitting on it would assume the very identity this registration must test.

excludedAsControl.name: west_playground_area_centroid
excludedAsControl.why: Unknown identity: this is the OSM way/1418127159 area centroid, not proven to be the Owl. Using it as a control would beg the Owl identity question.

excludedAsControl.name: snowy_owl_graphic
excludedAsControl.why: Feature being resolved, not a control; fitting on it then reporting it 'resolved' is circular.

fit.model: affine: world = A * [px, py, 1] (least squares, dense normal equations); separate coefficients per axis
fit.interpretation: Unmodified 5-control RMS is 10.9 m (max 18.8 m). Leave-one-out spreads to ~54 m, which is expected for a 5-point affine over a ~300 m span; it bounds the lever-arm sensitivity of the far control. This is a ~15-25 m APPROXIMATE registration, not survey grade. NEVER prune controls to force a low RMS and never select only the points that agree.

outsideControls.name: atlas_crane (OSM node/9521067431)
outsideControls.note: Independent held-out OSM point; 6.5 m registration error confirms the fit is sane. The map illustration draws the crane jib above its foot, so the foot pixel is the registered point.

features.name: Snowy Owl Play Theatre
features.pxBasis: Captain read the Owl graphic BASE centre (NOT the head, NOT a fixture centre)
features.resolution: The Owl theatre is drawn WEST of the Fire Hall on the NORTH-UP 2026 map, ~46.8 m west of the Fire Hall body. It sits INSIDE the OSM unnamed west playground (way/1418127159), whose centroid is a generic area point, not the Owl. Maker/published pin 43.6462889,-79.3496804 is ~76 m from this registered point and lies to the NORTH-EAST, so the pin is an approximate maker location, NOT the structure footprint.

witnessFalseControl.name: west_playground_centroid
witnessFalseControl.why: Distance from the registered Owl base to the OSM area centroid; shows the area centroid is NOT the Owl (the very false identity this registration rejects).

evidence: 2026 City map (north-up) Owl graphic west of Fire Hall
OSM way/1418127159 unnamed west playground polygon
Captain photo review of maker images (identity only; no measured footprint)

features.name: Old Fire Hall 30
features.pxBasis: Captain read the Fire Hall body centroid (also the control)
features.resolution: Old Fire Hall 30 is a real park building and this registration control. Current OSM way/494886782 carries it at 43.6458536,-79.349925 (world 2389.5, 647.6). The committed native 3D-massing row at world (2384, 622) is the SAME building at its pre-relocation position: the current building is displaced ~26 m from the native row (mostly +z/south), consistent with the Captain's 'relocated ~24 m' note. Identity confirmed; the native row needs a position update, not suppression.

features.name: The Drum
features.pxBasis: Captain read the small grey ring centre east of the Fire Hall
features.resolution: The Drum (architect Tawar, circular annulus on V-posts) is drawn EAST of the Fire Hall. Registered from the map ring centre; a nearby 'The Drum' label text is NOT the structure. Built-form identity confirmed by Captain's /captain/drum-built.png photo; position is map-approximate ~15 m.
evidence: 2026 City map ring icon east of Fire Hall

features.name: Badlands Scramble
features.pxBasis: Captain read the Badlands map marker; ALSO has OSM polygon (way/1418541993) for an independent check
features.resolution: Badlands is a laid area, so its OSM polygon exists; the map marker is approximate. Use the OSM polygon centroid for extent-critical work; use this anchor only as a check. Marker is SOUTH-WEST of the Owl base, as Captain described (Badlands south-west of Owl).

features.name: Cableway Canyon
features.pxBasis: Captain read Cableway Canyon map label vicinity (feature is 20/40 m cableways, a wide low feature)
features.resolution: Cableway Canyon is a linear/slope feature (20 m + 40 m cableways) west of the Owl; the map shows it as a zone, so a single anchor is only a centre reference with ~25 m error. Living City text places Outdoor Fitness 'west of Cableway Canyon' but publishes no point; fitness therefore remains UNPLACED until an orthophoto/photo, NOT anchored from this label.

features.name: Swing Hill
features.pxBasis: Captain read Swing Hill map label vicinity
features.resolution: Swing Hill is a small play feature north-west of the Owl base in the west play cluster; map zone only, so the anchor is approximate and should be treated as a cluster reference, not a surveyed point.

features.name: Raccoon Picnic Terrace
features.pxBasis: Captain read the picnic-terrace marker EAST of the Fire Hall (NOT the Raccoon structure itself)
features.resolution: This pixel is the PICNIC TERRACE marker, not the Reaching Raccoon structure. The Raccoon structure has its own OSM polygon (way/1418796674) and is NOT placed from this marker. Recorded to prevent the terrace marker being mistaken for the Raccoon.

features.name: Canoe Cove east launch
features.pxBasis: Captain read the east Canoe Cove launch label
features.resolution: Canoe Cove is mapped as a point (OSM node/10893913022) but the launch/landing labels are map-approximate, not surveyed paddling-course extents. The course extent is not published; do not infer it from these anchors.

features.name: Canoe Cove west landing
features.pxBasis: Captain read the west Canoe Cove landing label
features.resolution: West landing on the cove; map-approximate, same caveat as the east launch.

features.name: West Promontory
features.pxBasis: Captain read the west Promontory label (western edge of the map)
features.resolution: The ~9 m western promontory (MVVA) is a landform, drawn at the map's western edge. The anchor is a coarse centre with ~30 m error. This is a terrain feature, not a structure; a walkable relief mesh is a separate future build decision, not derivable from this point.

features.name: Atlas Crane
features.pxBasis: Captain read the mapped crane FOOT base (NOT the illustrated jib top)
features.resolution: Atlas Crane is an OSM node (9521067431) at 43.6435284,-79.3538817. Registered from the map foot, it lands 6.5 m from the OSM node, confirming the registration and showing the jib illustration is displaced but the foot is faithful. Use the OSM node for the crane.

features.name: Outdoor Fitness Equipment
features.resolution: City Recreation page (2026-09-09) states fitness equipment is west of Cableway Canyon but publishes no point. It is NOT pictured as its own icon on the 2026 map. Left UNPLACED; do not derive a coordinate from the cableway label.

buildingsPolicy.note: Do NOT blanket-suppress the 9 native in-park 3D-massing rows. Each row needs its own source identity and a 2026 photo before any change.

identified.action: reposition to current OSM; identity confirmed; native location is the pre-relocation position (~26 m south displacement)

unidentifiedCandidates.note: Largest in-park massing row (26.1 m). NOT proven an old warehouse and NOT proven a greenfield render error. Requires a current 2025/2026 photo and a City 3D-Massing/permit record before any decision. Its height alone proves nothing.
Near the Atlas Crane foot (OSM node 2014.8,799.8 — ~18 m). Plausibly crane equipment/base, not a shed; verify before any action.
Sits right where the Owl maker pin projects (world 2422.2,606.9), but the registered Owl base is ~46 m west. Do not equate this low row with the Owl theatre without a photo.
